title: power
summary: 1S protected LiPo on J1 (JST PH). SW1 is the main power switch in the battery line: off disconnects everything, so charging through the XIAO also needs SW1 on. After the switch the cell (VBAT) goes to the MCU page, where the charge-link jumper feeds the XIAO, and to U1. U1 (TPS7A2033, 7 uVrms) makes the partners' +3.3V analog rail directly from the cell; its EN has an internal 500k pulldown, so the analog side stays off until the MCU drives ANA_EN high. No boost converter anywhere: the LDO holds 3.3 V until the cell is near empty.

components.why: 1S LiPo connector. CHECK POLARITY of every pack: JST PH vendors disagree on which pin is +
main power switch; throw B unused
low-noise 3.3 V analog rail straight from the cell, no switching regulator
LDO input capacitor, at the pin
LDO output capacitor (required for stability), at the pin

+3.3V.note: TPS7A20 rating; the analog side draws about 3 mA

ANA_EN.needs: logic high (>= VEN(HI)) to enable; floating = off

VBAT.note: switched cell, to the XIAO via the charge-link jumper
